# Block-level list items

- > Quote item text stays beside the bullet and wraps across the item column.
  >
  > Quote continuation stays in the item column.
- # Heading item stays beside its bullet.
- ```text
  let code = "code item";
  ```
- ![Missing image item](missing.png)
- - Nested item stays beside the outer bullet.
  - Nested continuation stays indented.
